note: This compares the LLM JUDGE (evaluation/judge.py) against an LLM-PROXY second annotator (see annotator_type field in human_calibration_completed.jsonl) -- NOT genuine human-vs-LLM agreement. Both raters are LLMs; treat this as a same-class calibration check, not inter-rater reliability with a human.
escalation_decision_agreement_note: The LLM judge (evaluation/judge.py) does not output an escalation decision -- it only scores reply quality dimensions. There is no judge-vs-human escalation agreement to compute. Human-vs-SYSTEM escalation agreement is reported separately in escalation_metrics.json (Step 4).
